openocd.description: OpenOCD carrying AGM's 'riscv -dap' target extension. Stock upstream and OSS CAD Suite OpenOCD lack it. Every bundle ships one compatible build under tools/openocd; its root is passed to build_bundle.py --openocd, and `agamemnon doctor` verifies the '-dap' target is present in the binary.

linux.source: build the base commit with AGM's riscv -dap target extension
linux.note: AGM ships the extension prebuilt for Windows only. A Linux/macOS bundle builds the pinned base commit with the AGM target applied, or extracts the openocd binary from an installed vendor toolchain. If the AGM target source is unavailable for a platform, that is the remaining blocker to a fully self-contained non-Windows bundle.
